renderedAbilities.renderedText: Choose a mask until removed. Mourner grants +10 Speed and imposes Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against it. Accuser adds its Proficiency Bonus as Psychic damage to its first hit each turn against a Frightened creature. Saint ends one condition and grants Advantage on its next saving throw before the end of its next turn. Fire suppresses the benefit until its next turn. While Grappled or Restrained, an adjacent creature can use an action and pass an Athletics or Sleight of Hand check against the save DC to remove the mask.
